blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text encoders turn earnings calls into vectors for search, for language models that answer from retrieved passages, and for forecasting models. A live retriever can use an encoder trained once on all available text, as finance retrievers are, but a backtest needs an encoder that read no text written after the date of each vector. To address this look-ahead bias, from 412,248 calls we train vintages under four pretraining recipes, with yearly cutoffs from 2010 to 2024, and each vintage reads only text dated on or before its cutoff. We then fine-tune each vintage on the question-answer pairs of the calls themselves. The vintages we train on calls alone, with 33.8M parameters, retrieve answers on held-out calls better than the general retrievers we tested in every test quarter. Their vectors also raise by about half the rank correlation between next-day returns and forecasts built from past returns and firm size. When each vintage continues the previous one, a later vintage retrieves better on earlier quarters than the vintage available at the time, and a point-in-time language model that answers from the passages the later vintage retrieves inherits the gain. The 2024 vintage of our families also forecasts earnings surprises better, although the interval of this gain includes zero on calls that no vintage read. It forecasts returns no better, so point-in-time vintages matter most for retrieval and little for forecasts of returns.
blocks.zh: 文本编码器将收益调用转换为矢量搜索,从检索段落中解答的语言模型,以及预测模型. 活取回器可以像财务取回器一样,使用在所有可用文本上训练过一次的编码器,但是回取回器需要读取每个向量日期后未写出文本的编码器. 为了解决这种外观偏好,从412,248个电话到4个训练前的食谱,我们每年在2010年至2024年期间对葡萄酒进行培训,每个葡萄酒只读到其停产时或之前的文本。 然后,我们微调每个古董 在答题对 自己。 单凭我们所训练的调频器,有33.8M参数, 比每个测试区测试的普通调频器更能检索到被扣的调频器的答案。 它们的矢量还使下一天的返回与过去返回和坚固规模的预测之间的排名关联增加了大约一半。 当每个版本延续上一个版本时,后一个版本比当时可用的版本在更早的部位检索得更好,一个从后一个版本检索的段落中解答的点入语言模型继承了收益. 我们家庭的2024年历史也预示着收入会更惊人,尽管这一年收入的间隔包括不读任何年岁的电话上的零。 它预测回报不会更好,因此时间点值对于检索最为重要,对于预测回报则很少。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: A retriever returns the passages of a corpus most relevant to a query, and its encoder maps each passage and each query to a vector. Over earnings calls, a retriever lets an analyst search hundreds of thousands of calls for statements worded differently from the query. It also supplies the passages from which a language model answers, so the quality of retrieval caps the quality of the answer, and the vectors of its encoder can enter a forecasting model directly. When the retrieved passages only inform a live reader, the retriever can use an encoder trained on the whole corpus, because every text it read was written before the query. Many uses instead treat the passages or the vectors as what was known at a past date, as in a backtest of a forecasting model, a strategy or an agent. Every vector used at date t t must then come from an encoder that stopped reading before t t . For example, [ 1 ] build topic factors for asset pricing from news with a pretrained sentence encoder that has seen text from a period overlapping their evaluation sample. Its vectors may therefore encode information that was not available on the date of an article. For a language model, [ 2 ] note that a backtest produces biased results if the training and backtesting periods overlap, with look-ahead bias as one source. An encoder that read later text is open to the same bias.
blocks.zh: 检索器返回与查询最相关的一个实体的段落,其编码器将每个段落和每个查询映射到一个向量. 在收入电话上,一个检索器让分析师搜索了几十万个与查询不同的语句电话. 它还提供一个语言模型从中解答的段落,因此检索的质量会给答案的质量盖上帽子,而其编码器的向量可以直接输入一个预测模型. 当取回的段落只通知一个活读取器时,取取取器可以使用一个经过整本命题训练的编码器,因为所读到的每个文本都是在查询之前所写的. 许多人将通道或矢量视为过去的日期所知道的情况,例如在预测模型、策略或剂的后置测试中。 在日期t t 中使用的每个向量都必须来自一个编码器,在 t t 之前停止读取. 例如,[1]用一个预先经过培训的句子编码器从新闻中构建资产定价的专题因素,该编码器从某一时期的文本与评价样本相重叠。 因此,其矢量可以编码文章日期没有的信息。 对于一种语言模型,[2]注意,如果培训和反测试期相重叠,反测试会产生偏差的结果,而外观偏差是一个来源. 一个读取后期文本的编码器会打开同样的偏差.

blocks.en: Point-in-time language models remove look-ahead bias from the language model itself by training a sequence of models, called vintages, each only on text dated before its cutoff. ChronoBERT and ChronoGPT [ 3 ] , DatedGPT [ 4 ] and the point-in-time models of [ 5 ] train on general text and judge their vintages through portfolios built on the models’ signals. For decoder signals on next-day returns from news, [ 6 ] find that a newer vintage performs no better than the one it replaced on the same evaluation window, and argue that the annual pretraining run is not necessary. However, a dated language model protects a backtest only if the encoder that retrieves or embeds its input is dated as well, and these vintages are not trained to retrieve. Moreover, [ 7 ] identify retrieval from an external knowledge base as a second source of look-ahead bias, after the model’s own training data, and call for point-in-time data and version-controlled corpora with explicit as-of metadata. Similarly, [ 8 ] include embedding models among the components that must be versioned, since each can encode later information.
blocks.zh: 即时语言模型通过训练一系列的模型来从语言模型本身中去除外观-头部偏差,这些模型称为"花花相公"(vintages),每个模型只收录在被截断之前的文本上. ChronoBERT和ChronoGPT [3], DatedGPT [4] 以及[5] 普通文本列车的时点模型,并通过基于模型信号的组合来判断其版本. 对于第二天新闻回报的解码器信号, [6] 发现一个更新版本的性能并不比它在同一评价窗口所替换的要好,并认为年度预训运行没有必要. 然而,只有当检索或嵌入其输入的编码器也注明了日期时,过时的语言模型才保护回检,而这些版本没有经过检索的培训. 此外,[7] 将外部知识库的检索确定为在模型本身的培训数据之后出现前瞻偏差的第二个来源,并要求提供时点数据和有明确元数据的版本控制公司。 同样地,[8]将嵌入模型纳入必须版本的组件中,因为每个组件都可以编码后期信息.

blocks.en: To our knowledge, the leak through the encoder of a retriever has not been measured, although finance retrievers exist [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] . Each fine-tunes a general encoder, whose training cutoff is unknown, on queries or relevance labels at least partly produced by a language model, and no paper among them states the cutoff of its encoder.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,虽然财务回收商存在[9、10、11],但是没有测量出一个回收商的编码器泄露的情况。 每个微调一个一般编码器,其训练截断未知,至少部分通过语言模型制作的查询或相关标签,其中没有纸张说明其编码器的截断.

blocks.en: A point-in-time retriever for earnings calls faces two obstacles. Calls before 2010 are few, so a vintage with a 2010 cutoff can read only 0.302 647 296 0.302\,647\,296 B tokens of calls, while a general encoder pretrains on hundreds of billions of tokens. Scoring each yearly vintage also requires retrieval questions dated after its cutoff, and labeling such questions for every year is costly. We address the first obstacle by comparing recipes that read only calls with recipes that start from an encoder of general text. We address the second obstacle with the calls themselves. Each analyst question is followed by an executive’s answer, so the calls supply dated question-answer pairs without the need for labels, for training as well as for evaluation on calls held out from training.
blocks.zh: 追收收入的点球手面临两个障碍。 2010年之前的电话是很少的,所以带有2010年截断的旧电话只能读作0.302 647 296 0.302\ 647\ 296 呼叫的B符号, 而一个通用编码器 预留了上千亿个符号。 对每一年的花瓶进行分红也需要取回其停产后的日期问题,每年给这些问题贴上标签费用很高。 我们解决了第一个障碍,将只读取呼叫的食谱同从一般文本编码器开始的食谱进行比较。 我们用电话解决第二个障碍。 每个分析师的问题后面都有一个执行官的回答,因此,电话供应注明了问题答案,而不需要标签、培训以及评估从培训中发出的电话。

blocks.en: From 412 , 248 412,248 earnings calls held between September 2004 and September 2026, we train yearly vintages with cutoffs from 2010 to 2024, either from scratch on a fixed token budget or chained. A chained vintage continues the pretraining of the previous vintage on the new year’s calls, which is continual pretraining on a chronologically ordered stream of text [ 12 ] . Two further families start from ChronoBERT’s vintages, one of them continued on our calls by domain-adaptive pretraining (DAPT) [ 13 ] . We then apply contrastive fine-tuning to every vintage, on the question-answer pairs dated on or before its cutoff. We evaluate the vintages through retrieval on calls held out from pretraining and fine-tuning and through forecasts of returns and fundamentals. In both uses, we measure the look-ahead premium, which is the change in a score when a later vintage replaces the one available at the time. 1 1 1 https://github.com/Alessiobrini/point-in-time-encoders-for-earnings-calls holds the code, the call identifiers, and the result files and training records from which we build every table and every figure of results. The transcripts are licensed and are not redistributed. We make three main contributions: 1. We build point-in-time retrievers for earnings calls and compare four training recipes. The vintages we train on calls alone, with 33.826 176 33.826\,176 M parameters, retrieve answers better than the general retrievers we tested, of up to 335M parameters, in every test quarter. An encoder with pretraining alone retrieves far worse than one with contrastive fine-tuning, and between our recipes, recall depends on how much of its window a vintage reads. 2. We show that point-in-time call embeddings forecast next-day returns beyond baselines built from past returns and firm size, in a design adapted from [ 3 ] . The embeddings raise the rank correlation of the baseline forecasts with next-day returns by about half, a statistically significant increase. 3. We measure look-ahead through the encoder and find that it depends on how the vintages are trained and on what the vectors are used for. A chained vintage that has read the year of the test quarter retrieves better than the vintage available at the time. A replay control that trains for the same number of tokens on text it has already read does not, so the gain comes from the later text. A later vintage of the family trained from scratch on a fixed budget shows no net gain, so the measured premium in retrieval depends on the recipe. A point-in-time language model that answers from the passages that a later chained vintage retrieves inherits the chained gain. The 2024 vintage of our families improves forecasts of fundamentals, although on calls that no vintage read the interval of its gain on the earnings surprise includes zero. Return forecasts with these families show no such improvement at any horizon we test, from the next day to the next quarter.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: DAPT continues the pretraining of a general encoder on text of the target domain before fine-tuning, and [ 13 ] find that this second phase of pretraining leads to performance gains in four domains. In finance, FinEAS [ 14 ] fine-tunes sentence embeddings for financial sentiment, and FinBERT [ 15 ] pretrains an encoder on filings, call transcripts and analyst reports. The finance retrievers discussed in Sec. I then train general encoders on queries or labels that are at least partly generated. On earnings calls, [ 16 ] train a retriever of call content together with a generator of the questions analysts may ask. EvasionBench [ 17 ] extracts 22.7 million question-answer pairs from Capital IQ transcripts and trains a classifier of evasive answers on 84,000 labeled ones. We use such pairs as supervision for retrievers, dated so that each vintage trains only on pairs dated on or before its cutoff.
blocks.zh: DAPT在微调前继续就目标域文本进行一般编码器的预训,并 [13] 发现这一第二阶段的预训导致四个领域的性能提高. 在金融方面,FinEAS[14]微调了嵌入金融情绪的句子,FinBERT[15]预留了备案编码,调用笔录和分析报告. 财务回收商在Sec讨论。 然后,我训练一般编码器 查询或标签 至少部分生成。 在打收入电话时,[16] 培训拨打内容的检索员以及分析人员可能提出的问题的生成者。 Evasion Bench [17] 从Capital IQ语录中提取出2,270万个问答对子,并在84,000个被贴上标签的语录上训练出一个可回避答案的分类器. 我们使用这样的对子作为回收器的监管, 日期,这样每对老式列车 只在它的截取日期或之前的对上。

blocks.en: Look-ahead bias has been measured through the way a model is used. For instance, [ 18 ] estimate from a date-only recall query how likely a model is to know a firm’s realized outcome, and find that forecasts from news headlines and from earnings calls gain predictive power where that likelihood is high. DatedGPT [ 4 ] finds a significant look-ahead premium when a prompted model forecasts returns from news headlines and was trained on text from the outcome period. Through frozen embeddings, [ 3 ] find no evidence that access to future information improves the performance of return portfolios in what they call their cleanest test for look-ahead bias. In that test, the vintage whose training text includes the test year replaces the one whose text ends the year before, so the two differ by one year of text. In retrieval-augmented systems, [ 19 ] make a passage eligible only if its timestamp precedes the prediction time, while the models that read the passages are not dated. In addition, [ 20 ] name a retriever’s parameters as a channel of hindsight leakage and keep them fixed in their experiments.
blocks.zh: 仰视-前向偏差是通过模型的使用方式来衡量的. 例如,[18] 从仅日期召回的查询中估算出一个模型是否有可能知道公司已实现的结果,并发现新闻头条和收入呼吁的预测在这种可能性高的地方获得预测力。 DatedGPT [4] 发现,当一个被提示的模型预测从新闻头条回来,并接受结果期文字培训时,会发现一个显著的外观-前瞻溢价. 通过被冻结的嵌入,[3]没有发现任何证据表明,在他们所称最清洁的外观偏差测试中,获得未来信息可以改善返回组合的性能. 在该测试中,其培训文本包括测试年的用法取代了文本结束于前一年的用法,因此两者因文本的用法而异. 在被取回的系统中,[19]只有当其时间戳在预测时间之前,而读取段落的模型没有日期时,才使一段合格. 此外,[20]将取回器的参数命名为后发渗漏的通道并固定在实验中.

blocks.en: Point-in-time models also differ in how they train a sequence of vintages. DatedGPT trains each yearly model from scratch on an equal budget, which is our first recipe. In contrast, [ 5 ] train decoders on one trillion chronologically filtered tokens in a single run and release monthly checkpoints. Without a yearly pretraining run, [ 6 ] fit a low-rank adapter on text published before each decision date and leave the pretrained weights unchanged. ChronoBERT [ 3 ] is the closest work. Each of its yearly encoders continues the previous one on the new year’s text at a constant learning rate, which is our second recipe. Its chain reads general text, while ours reads earnings calls, the text our tests are about. To that design, we add contrastive fine-tuning for retrieval, a family trained from scratch on domain text, and a replay control that distinguishes later text from longer training.
blocks.zh: 时点模型在如何训练出一串花序上也有所不同. DatedGPT从头到尾地训练每个年度模型 在一个平等的预算, 这是我们的第一个食谱。 相形之下,[5]个列车解码器在一次运行中按一兆个时间顺序过滤出代号,并放出月检. 没有每年的预训运行,[6]在每一决定日期之前公布的文本上安装了低等适配器,并保持预训权重不变. ChronoBERT [3] 是最近的作品. 每一名年度编码员都以不断学习的速度在新年的文本上延续上一个编码,这是我们的第二个配方。 它的链条读一般文本, 而我们的阅读收入呼叫, 我们测试的文本。 在这个设计中,我们添加了对比度的微调以进行检索,一个从零开始在域名文本上训练的家庭,以及一个将后期文本与更长时间的训练区分开的回放控制.

blocks.en: III Corpus and the Point-in-Time Protocol
blocks.zh: 三. 公司与时间点协议

blocks.en: A vintage is point in time only if every text it reads carries a date, and only if the firms in the corpus do not depend on which firms survived. We take every earnings call in the Capital IQ transcripts on Wharton Research Data Services (WRDS), 412 , 248 412,248 calls of more than 16,000 firms from September 2004 to September 2026, and keep every firm, whether or not it is still listed. Our vintages read calls through 2024, and our tests use calls through 2025. Capital IQ often holds several versions of one call, and no collection type is consistently the most complete, so we keep the version with the most text. 2 2 2 Capital IQ holds 3.2 transcripts per call on average, of collection types such as edited and audited copies, and revises them for weeks after the call. The version we keep can thus postdate the cutoff of a vintage that reads it, although it transcribes the same call, whose content was public once the call ended. We keep such a late version for 0.317 939 602 631 275 6 0.317\,939\,602\,631\,275\,6 % to 1.394 138 149 090 427 9 1.394\,138\,149\,090\,427\,9 % of the calls a vintage can train on at each cutoff from 2011 to 2024, and 6.684 182 275 334 067 6.684\,182\,275\,334\,067 % at the 2010 cutoff. We date a call by its event date in Capital IQ. Membership in the S&P 500 at the date of each call comes from the index history of the Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP), and we use it only for the calls with fundamental targets in Sec. VI .

blocks.en: A call is a sequence of speaker turns, a presentation by executives followed by questions from analysts and answers from executives. We split each call into chunks of about 2,400 characters, or about 500 tokens, and break a longer turn at a paragraph or sentence boundary. The chunks are the units that a vintage reads in pretraining and that we average into a call vector. In the question-and-answer section, a chunk starts at an analyst’s question and holds the answers that follow it. We drop the turns of the call’s operator, who introduces each analyst, unless a turn has at least 1,000 characters, since Capital IQ sometimes attributes a whole call to the operator. Each analyst question followed directly by an executive’s turn gives one question-answer pair, and we keep a pair only if both turns have at least 120 characters, so we drop short turns such as thanks and greetings. We also take pairs only from calls that offer at least 5 answers of that length.
blocks.zh: 电话是演讲者转接的顺序,由高管介绍,然后由分析师提问,由高管回答. 我们把每个调用分成大约2400个字符, 或大约500个符号, 在段落或句子边界上打破一个更长的转折。 块是葡萄酒在预训中读取的单位,我们平均是呼叫矢量。 在问答部分,一个小块从分析师的问题开始,并持有随之而来的答案。 我们放下电话接线员的转弯,他介绍每个分析员,除非一个接线员至少有1000个字符,因为Capital IQ有时会把整通电话归结给接线员。 每一个分析师的问题,然后是行政主管直接回答一个问题,我们只保留一个问题,只要两个问题至少有120个字符,我们就会减少简短的问题,例如感谢和问候。 我们还只从至少提供5个如此长的答复的电话中取出一对。

blocks.en: We hold out 10% of calls, each in its entirety, from pretraining and contrastive fine-tuning. 3 3 3 We hold out a call when the first four bytes of the SHA-1 hash of its Capital IQ event identifier, prefixed with the string ecalls-holdout-v1: , fall in the lowest tenth of their range as a big-endian integer. The rule does not need a stored list, so anyone with the identifiers can reproduce the split. The split is by call, so no chunk and no pair of a held-out call reaches any vintage, and every retrieval question comes from these calls.
blocks.zh: 我们持有10%的电话, 每一个完整的, 通过预训和对比微调。 3,3,我们发出一个呼叫,当它的Capital IQ事件标识符的前4个字节SHA-1散列,前缀为字符串 ecalls-holdout-v1:,作为大端整数,跌入其最小的十分之一. 该规则不需要被存储列表,因此任何拥有标识符的人都可以复制分解. 拆分是通过呼叫,所以没有块和一对被搁置的呼叫到达任何等效,每个检索问题都来自这些呼叫.

blocks.en: IV Point-in-Time Encoders
blocks.zh: 四. 时间点编码器

blocks.en: We compare four recipes that differ in the encoder and in what it reads before contrastive fine-tuning, and we give every recipe the same fine-tuning, so a difference in retrieval comes from pretraining (Table II ).

blocks.en: Our encoder follows the ModernBERT architecture [ 21 ] , with 12 layers, a hidden size of 384 and 33.826 176 33.826\,176 M parameters. Its size is close to the 33.4M parameters of bge-small [ 22 ] , so a difference from bge-small reflects how the model was trained rather than its size. It pretrains by masked language modeling and predicts 30% of the tokens of each 768-token sequence, chosen at random. Every vintage uses one tokenizer, a byte-level byte-pair encoding (BPE) with 32,768 tokens fitted on every call dated on or before 2010, held-out calls included. These calls precede every cutoff and every test quarter, so the tokenizer reads no text after any cutoff. We split every digit into its own token, because with whole numbers, years such as 2008 and 2015 are single tokens while 2019 and 2024 are two, and a model could date a text by how its years split.
blocks.zh: 我们的编码器遵循现代BERT架构[21],有12层,隐藏大小为384和33.826 176 33.826\176 M参数. 它的大小接近于bge-small [22]的33.4M参数,因此与bge-small的区别反映了模型是如何训练的而不是其大小. 它通过蒙面语言模型预示,并预测出每个768个托肯序列的30%的符号,随机选择. 每个版本都使用一个代号器,一个字节级字节-pair编码(BPE),每一次2010年或之前的呼叫上都安装了32,768个代号,其中包括被搁置的呼叫。 这些呼叫在每一个截断和每个测试季度之前,所以任何截断之后的标语符不读出文本. 我们把每个数字分割成自己的代号,因为用整个数字,2008年和2015年等年份是单个代号,而2019年和2024年则是两个代号,一个模型可以按其年份的分出方式来约会一个文本.

blocks.en: In the from-scratch family, we train each vintage Y Y from random weights on window Y Y , for 1.2B tokens at every cutoff. With an equal budget, only the window varies from one vintage to the next, as in DatedGPT. At 1.2B tokens, the 2010 vintage reads its 0.302 647 296 0.302\,647\,296 B tokens about four times, and [ 23 ] find for decoder language models that up to 4 epochs of repeated data change the loss little against unique data. The 2024 vintage reads less than half of its window, so we also train a 2024 vintage on twice the tokens to measure what the budget costs.

blocks.en: The chained family follows the chain of ChronoBERT. Its 2010 vintage is the from-scratch one, and each later vintage Y Y continues vintage Y − 1 Y-1 for one pass over the calls of year Y Y , so the chained 2024 vintage has read 3.5B tokens. ChronoBERT trains its chain at a constant learning rate, while we give each segment a fresh optimizer and its own warmup and decay. Every chained vintage thus ends its training at a tenth of its peak learning rate, as a from-scratch vintage does. To distinguish the effect of later text from that of longer training (Sec. The replay trains for as many tokens as the next segment reads, so we compare repeated with unique data at equal compute, as in [ 23 ] .

For ChronoBERT + contrastive fine-tuning, we apply our fine-tuning to the ChronoBERT vintage directly. To test whether domain text helps an encoder of fixed size, for ChronoBERT + DAPT we first continue its masked language modeling on our window for 1.2B tokens, with ChronoBERT’s own tokenizer. We run this recipe at the 2010, 2017 and 2024 cutoffs.
blocks.zh: 另外两种配方从ChronoBERT的同名同名剪接器开始,编码器为149.014 272 149.014\,272 M参数在460B到525B符号上预加了一般文本. 对于ChronoBERT + 对比度微调,我们直接将微调应用到ChronoBERT的花纹上. 为了测试域名文本是否有助于固定大小的编码器,对于ChronoBERT + DAPT,我们首先在我们的窗口上继续用ChronoBERT 的自有的标语来进行遮掩的语言模型制作. 我们在2010年,2017年和2024年的断档时运行这个食谱.

blocks.en: In contrastive fine-tuning, we turn an encoder into a retriever by training it on the question-answer pairs of trainable calls dated on or before the vintage’s cutoff. We use an InfoNCE loss [ 24 ] that raises the cosine similarity of a question with its own answer against the other answers in the batch. Each batch holds up to 16 pairs, drawn at random, from each of 32 calls, about 370 to 405 pairs on average depending on the cutoff. Each question thus faces up to 15 answers from its own call and the rest from other calls. The batch size sets the number of negatives, so we keep it the same on every GPU by gradient caching [ 25 ] , which assembles the gradient of the full batch from pieces that fit in memory. Every vintage of every recipe trains for 4,000 steps (Table III ) and represents a text by the mean of its token vectors. As in pretraining, the fixed budget means that the 2010 vintage reads each pair about three times and the 2024 vintage two fifths of its pairs. blocks.en: To measure how well each vintage retrieves without letting it score text it was trained on, we draw every question from the held-out calls of Sec. III , on which no vintage trained. For each cutoff Y Y , we sample 400 held-out calls from the second quarter of year Y + 1 Y+1 and draw 3,000 of their question-answer pairs at random. We thus score each vintage on calls after its cutoff, as it would be deployed, rather than on one quarter shared by every vintage, which would favor the vintages whose windows end closest to it. We take the second quarter to leave a quarter between the cutoff and the test calls and to avoid the year-end calls of the first quarter. A dense retriever ranks the candidate answers to a question by the cosine similarity of their vectors to the question’s vector, and BM25 [ 26 ] by word overlap. Within-call recall@1 is the share of questions whose own answer ranks first among the executive turns of at least 120 characters in the question-and-answer section of the same call, where every candidate comes from the same firm. When a second executive also answers, ranking that turn first counts as a miss for every retriever alike. Cross-call recall@1 is the same share among those turns in every sampled call. Representations of call transcripts largely encode the identity of the firm [ 27 ] , so a retriever can succeed across calls by recognizing the firm. Within a call the firm is fixed, so we lead with the within-call task. A call offers a median of 21 21 to 27 27 candidate answers per question, depending on the quarter, so a random ranking reaches a within-call recall@1 of about 0.051 109 266 217 621 23 0.051\,109\,266\,217\,621\,23 . In both tasks we rank a correct answer tied with others below all of them. Every retriever answers the same sample of questions, so we compare two retrievers question by question and draw 95% intervals by resampling calls within each quarter. These intervals reflect the sampling of calls, since each vintage is one training run.

blocks.en: In our primary test, we compare the rank correlation with next-day returns of forecasts from text plus price baselines with that of baselines alone, in a design adapted from [ 3 ] to calls. The universe is every call since 2011 whose firm links, on the call date, to a common stock listed on NYSE, AMEX or Nasdaq. A call also needs a price of at least $5 at the last close before it, so firms enter and leave the sample. Since a call lasts about an hour, we enter a position at the close of the call date for a call starting by 15:00 New York time, and at the next trading day’s close otherwise. The primary target is the return over the trading day after entry minus the value-weighted market return. We also forecast, minus the market’s, the 5-day return after entry and the return over trading days + 2 +2 to + 61 +61 , where day 0 is the first trading day that closes after the call starts. For a call held before 08:30 or from 16:00, we add the raw open-to-close return of the first session after the call, which ends at the entry close. The price baselines are the market-adjusted reaction from the last close before the call to the entry close and the return over the week before the call. They also include momentum from twelve months to one month before the call and log market capitalization. For the next-quarter return, the announcement return over days − 1 -1 to + 1 +1 replaces the reaction, and the return over days − 21 -21 to − 2 -2 replaces that of the week. For the session after the call, the overnight gap to the session’s open replaces the reaction, which would contain the session itself.

blocks.en: We use two fundamental targets to measure whether text describes the firm’s next quarter, which a model trained on later text could know in advance. Both vary from one call to the next within a firm, and we compute them on the S&P 500 calls. The first is the standardized earnings surprise of the next fiscal quarter, which is the change in earnings per share from the same quarter a year earlier, scaled by price [ 29 ] . The second is abnormal volatility, after the text-based volatility forecasts of [ 30 ] . Abnormal volatility is the log ratio of the realized variance of daily returns on days + 2 +2 to + 21 +21 to that on days − 21 -21 to − 2 -2 . For the earnings surprise, the baselines are the current surprise, which is that of the quarter the call reports, the announcement return, momentum and market capitalization. For abnormal volatility, they are the log realized variances of the stock on days − 6 -6 to − 2 -2 , − 21 -21 to − 2 -2 and − 252 -252 to − 22 -22 , after the heterogeneous autoregressive model of [ 31 ] . They also include that of the market on days − 21 -21 to − 2 -2 , the announcement return, its absolute value and market capitalization.
blocks.zh: 我们使用两个基本指标来衡量案文是否描述了公司的下个季度,一个经过以后文本培训的模型可以事先知道。 公司内部的两次通话都不同,我们根据S&P 500的通话来计算。 第一个是下一个财会季度的标准化收益出乎意料,即每股收入与前一年同期相比的变化,按价格调整[29]。 第二种是异常波动,在[30]的文本波动预测之后。 异常起伏是日数+2+2至+21+21日数日数日数日数已实现回数相差的对数比−21-21至−2-2. 对于收入惊喜而言,基线是当前的惊喜,即呼叫报告、公告回报、势头和市场资本化季度的惊喜。 对于异常起伏性,在[31]的多种自递回式模型之后,它们是库存在-6至2-2天、21至21至2-2天和252至252至22-22天的对数已实现差异。 它们还包括市场日-21-21至-2-2天的市场、宣布回报、其绝对价值和市场资本化。

blocks.en: Each January from 2013, so that the first fit trains on two years of calls, we fit a ridge regression on every earlier call whose target was known before January 1. We choose the penalty among the six powers of ten from 0.1 to 10 4 10^{4} by cross-validation over four time-ordered folds of these training calls and winsorize the target at the 1st and 99th percentiles of the training rows. The vector of a call is the mean of its chunk vectors, scaled to unit length, and the encoders with our contrastive fine-tuning read the first 512 tokens of each chunk. Vintage t − 1 t-1 , available at the time for test year t t , embeds the training and test calls alike. A call enters the regression through the first 32 principal components of its vector, fitted on the training calls, so every encoder adds the same number of predictors, independently of its dimension. Besides the encoders, the text sources are dictionary tone, the share of a call’s words that are negative minus the share that are positive in the dictionary of [ 32 ] , and term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF). TF-IDF enters as the first 32 singular components of the matrix of the calls’ words, fitted each January on calls whose return was known before the test year. We evaluate a forecast by the Spearman rank correlation between forecasts and realized targets across the calls of a calendar quarter, which finance calls the information coefficient (IC), a rank measure that suits forecasts used to sort calls. We average the IC over the 52 quarters from 2013 to 2025, 51 for the next-quarter return and the two fundamental targets, and compute its t t statistic across quarters.

Vintage t − 1t-1,在测试年份 t 时可用,嵌入了训练与测试调用相同. 一个调用通过它矢量的前32个主要组件进入回归,并被安装在训练调用上,因此每个编码器都添加了同样数量的预测器,独立于其尺寸. 除了编码器,文本来源是词典语气,一个调用单词中负数减去[32]词典中正数的分数,以及名词频率倒数文档频率(TF-IDF). blocks.en: VIII Conclusions
blocks.zh: 八. 结论

blocks.en: With contrastive fine-tuning on the calls’ own question-answer pairs, we obtain retrievers that rank answers better than the general retrievers we tested in every test quarter, at the size of bge-small and with a known cutoff. Their call embeddings also raise the next-day IC of the price baselines by about half. Used live, such a retriever gains from retraining as calls arrive, since newer chained vintages retrieve better on a fixed quarter. For encoders of this size on call text, the vintage available at the time is the one to use in a backtest of retrieval, of a language model that reads retrieved passages, or of a forecast.
blocks.zh: 通过对通话本身的对答进行对比性的微调,我们得到了比我们在每个测试季度测试的普通取回者更好的答覆,大小为bge-small并有已知的截断。 他们的"嵌入"呼吁还将价格基线的下一天IC提高了约一半. 利用现场直播,随着呼叫的到来,再培训的回收者会有所收获,因为更新的连锁葡萄酒在固定的季度回收得更好。 对于调用文本上的这种大小的编码器,当时可用的版本是用于回取测试,读取被检索段落的语言模型,或者预测.

blocks.en: Our results come from one corpus with point-in-time encoders of at most 149.014 272 149.014\,272 M parameters, and our training and test pairs need the question-answer turns of a call, which most news articles, filings and broker reports lack. The ChronoBERT-based recipes keep ChronoBERT’s tokenizer of 2024, which splits 2010 and 2024 call text into tokens at about the same rate. In the replay control we restart the learning-rate schedule as in our chain, so carrying its result to a chain trained at a constant rate, as ChronoBERT is, is an extrapolation. The gains from text in forecasts are small. Finally, we leave to future work whether the premium through the encoder grows with the size of the model, and whether the premium that reaches a language model grows with the size of the reader.
blocks.zh: 我们的检测结果来自一个定点编码器 最多149.014 272 149.014\,272 M参数, 以及我们的训练 和测试对 需要一个电话的问答转折, 大多数的新闻文章, 存档和经纪人报告缺乏。 基于ChronoBERT的食谱保留了ChronoBERT2024的活字符号,它将2010年和2024年的文字分成了大约相同的速度的活字符号. 在重放控制中,我们像在链中一样重启学习率表, 因此将结果带入一个以恒定速率训练的链, 就像ChronoBERT一样,是一种外推法。 在预测中从文本中获得的收益很小。 最后,我们留待将来的工作,通过编码器的溢价是否随着模型的大小而增加,以及到达语言模型的溢价是否随着读者的大小而增加.
